description: Confirms that the foundation Skill owns argv construction, exit-code routing, stdout/stderr separation, and identifier persistence.
expectations: Pre-flight runs `version` then `schema <command path>` before any other call
argv is always passed via list, never shell interpolation
`--format json` is the default for every machine-driven call
Failures are routed by numeric exit code and `error.requiredAction`, never by parsing the localized message
`exit code 20` resumes the same operation; it never authorizes a new submission
`--submit-id ""` is rejected with exit 2 and is the deliberate trap for missing variable expansions
stdout in `--format json` mode contains only the declared payload; stderr carries the failure envelope
`projectId` and `submitId` are persisted across processes; reusing the same `submitId` never re-bills
